concepts.def: Takes shape of container; particles slide
Single element or compound; sharp mp

walkthroughs.body_html:
In solids particles vibrate; in liquids they slide; in gases they move freely.

Energy is needed to overcome forces between particles when changing state.

A pure substance melts at a sharp temperature.

Impurities lower the mp and broaden the range.

This is used to check purity in industry.

Filtration: insoluble solid + liquid.

Crystallisation: dissolved solid from solution.

Distillation: liquids with different bp. Chromatography: coloured substances.
